notes: Highly irregular in the present tense (je vais, tu vas, il va, nous allons, vous allez, ils vont) and future stem (j'irai). Takes 'être' in the passé composé (je suis allé).

faults.why: Missing the essential A1/A2 sense as the near-future auxiliary ('be going to'), although mentioned in notes.

faults.quote: to form the near future (le futur composé).
faults.why: The French near future is called 'le futur proche', not 'le futur composé'.
'Aller' usually means 'to suit' (look good on); 'to fit' (size) is only with 'bien/mal'.
